([[Chatham, Virginia]]) | college = [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] (2012–2015) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * Karl Malone Award (2015) * First-team All-[[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] (2014) * Second-team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2015) * [[List of NCAA Men's Division I Basketball champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2013 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2013]]) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport | Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|the {{USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Under-19 World Championship|FIBA World U19 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold| [[2013 FIBA Under-19 World Championship|2013 Czech Republic]] | [[United States men's national basketball team|National team]]}} }} '''Montrezl Dashay Harrell''' (born January 26, 1994) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career at the [[University of Louisville]]. Harrell was a key player on the Cardinals' [[2012–13 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|2013 NCAA Tournament championship team]], their appearance in the [[2014 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2014 NCAA Tournament]], and has remained with the team for the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]]. Harrell would then declare for the [[2015 NBA Draft]] after Louisville's run in the NCAA tournament ended. ==High school career== Harrell, a 6'8" power forward from [[Tarboro, North Carolina]], starred at North Edgecombe High School before prepping for a year at [[Hargrave Military Academy]] in [[Chatham, Virginia]]. There he led the team to a 38–1 record while averaging 25.2 [[Points per game|points]] and 13.6 [[rebounds per game]].{{cite web| title = Montrezl Harrell bio| publisher = GoCards.com | date = | url =http://www.gocards.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/montrezl_harrell_815133.html | accessdate = August 31, 2013}} Originally Harrell committed to play college basketball for coach [[Seth Greenberg]] at [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]], but after Greenberg was fired, Harrell was released from his commitment and chose [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]].{{cite web| last = Goodman | first = Jeff | title = Louisville adds former Virginia Tech signee Montrezl Harrell| publisher = CBSSports.com | date = June 4, 2012 | url = http://www.cbssports.com/nba/eye-on-basketball/19255114/louisville-adds-former-virginia-tech-signee-harrell | accessdate = August 31, 2013}} ==College career== As a freshman, Harrell backed up [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] [[Chane Behanan]], averaging 5.7 points and 3.6 rebounds in 16.2 minutes per game. He played his best at the end of the season, scoring 20 points in the Cardinals' [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]] championship victory over [[2012–13 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]]. In his reserve role, Harrell helped the Cardinals win the [[2013 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2013 NCAA championship]] to cap his freshman season. With [[Gorgui Dieng]]'s departure for the [[2013 NBA draft]], Harrell received recognition in the offseason leading to his sophomore year as one of the top returning players in the country. The [[Sporting News]] selected Harrell to the preseason [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-America]] third team in its 2013–14 college basketball preview magazine.2013–14 Sporting News College Basketball Yearbook, page 9 Harrell decided to stay for his junior season instead of opting for the NBA. ==International career== In 2012, Harrell was a member of the United States team at the [[FIBA]] U18 World Championship that won Gold in [[São Paulo]], Brazil.{{cite web| title = 2012 FIBA Americas U18 Championship For Men| publisher = USA Basketball | date = | url =http://www.usab.com/mens/u18/mu18_2012.html | accessdate = August 31, 2013}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.gocards.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/montrezl_harrell_815133.html Louisville Cardinals bio] {{2013 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball navbox}} {{Persondata | NAME = Harrell, Montrezl | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = January 26, 1994 | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Harrell, Montrezl}} [[Category:1994 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players at the 2013 NCAA Men's Division I Final Four]] [[Category:Basketball players from North Carolina]] [[Category:Louisville Cardinals men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Tarboro, North Carolina]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]]
